summary.one_liner: Proofpoint's product page for Sendmail Sentrion Open Source, an enterprise-oriented offering built around the open source sendmail mail transfer agent (MTA), plus the sendmail project's security-reporting and PGP signing details.
use_cases: running an enterprise open source mail server
planning an enterprise email messaging roadmap
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Sendmail Sentrion as a Proofpoint enterprise platform for organizations that use open source sendmail in large, complex environments and want a messaging roadmap. The extracted text is mostly about security reporting: sendmail security problems go to a sendmail-security address with the year substituted, and reports should be PGP-encrypted using the key in the PGPKEYS file of the distribution. It notes that non-security questions should go to comp.mail.sendmail and Unix security questions to comp.security.unix. It also states that sendmail distributions are signed with a PGP key named "Sendmail Signing Key/YYYY", where YYYY is the release year. The page does not give features or pricing in the extracted text.
notable: Sendmail is an open source MTA, listed in awesome-selfhosted under Mail Transfer Agents
Sentrion is Proofpoint's enterprise platform built around open source sendmail
Distributions are PGP-signed with a per-year Sendmail Signing Key
caveats: Sentrion is a commercial enterprise offering; the page gives no pricing details
